overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Plan Commission was scheduled to hold a revised meeting to conduct public hearings and consider zoning and land use matters, including a zoning change request from Marathon County Highway Department and a conditional use permit application for a residential pond.

agenda.item: Call Meeting to Order, Pledge of Allegiance, Roll Call
Announcement of Public Hearing - Zoning Change Request (Marathon County Highway Department)
Announcement of Public Hearing - Conditional Use Permit (Zach & Abbigal Knetter)
Conditional Use Pond - Zach and Abbigal Knetter
CSM Happy Hollow Road - Dean Prohaska
Action on reviewing zoning and subdivision codes
Consideration of Items for Future Agenda

discussions.item: Zoning Change Request (Marathon County Highway Department)
discussions.body: The Marathon County Highway Department was scheduled to present a request for a zoning change of 25.24 acres from B3, SF, and AR zoning to M2 General Industrial at multiple properties along Old Highway 51. A public hearing was set to receive testimony on this rezoning proposal before the Commission took action.

Zach and Abbigal Knetter were scheduled to request a Conditional Use Permit for construction of a pond on the north side of their 15.47-acre property on Kronenwetter Drive. A public hearing was scheduled to allow community comment on this conditional use application.

The Commission was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on the rezoning request for the Marathon County Highway Department facility as presented during the public hearing portion of the meeting.
The Commission was scheduled to consider and take possible action on a Certified Survey Map related to the Marathon County Highway Department property.

discussions.item: Conditional Use Pond - Zach and Abbigal Knetter
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on the conditional use permit application for the residential pond on the Knetter property.

discussions.item: CSM Happy Hollow Road - Dean Prohaska
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to review and take possible action on a Certified Survey Map for property on Happy Hollow Road requested by Dean Prohaska.

discussions.item: Action on reviewing zoning and subdivision codes
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to consider and potentially take action regarding a comprehensive review of the Village's zoning and subdivision codes.
The Commission was scheduled to discuss and consider action on septic tank ordinance matters for the Village.
The Commission was scheduled to address and potentially take action on zoning or ordinance provisions related to twin homes and zero lot line developments.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled for up to 15 minutes total, with a three-minute time limit per person and possible extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on zoning change request for Marathon County Highway Department facility from B3, SF, and AR to M2 General Industrial
